requirements.title: Resolution order
requirements.rationale: A fork-only branch must get a local ref before the patch row is inserted, because rebuilds read only refs/heads/<branch>.

criteria.condition: a non-skipped registration names a branch whose refs/heads/<name>^{commit} resolves to a commit
criteria.action: report the resolution method local, write no ref, take no workspace lock and perform no fetch
criteria.contract: the method is local and the error is nil; the fetch stub and credential stub record 0 calls; refs/heads/feat is unchanged; the busy workspace lock does not matter, because TryLock is never called

setup: a bare fork and a clone as the trunk with refs/heads/feat present
a counting fetch stub, a counting credential stub and a wslock held by another operation
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin
check.pseudocode: before=revparse('refs/heads/feat'); m,err=hook(ctx,slug,'feat'); assert m=='local' && err==nil; assert fetchCalls==0 && credCalls==0; assert revparse('refs/heads/feat')==before

criteria.condition: refs/heads/<name> does not resolve and refs/remotes/origin/<name>^{commit} resolves to a commit, in either PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE mode
criteria.action: create refs/heads/<name> at that commit and report the resolution method origin_tracking
criteria.contract: the method is origin_tracking in both modes; refs/heads/feat equals refs/remotes/origin/feat; HEAD, the checked-out branch and git status are unchanged; no fetch occurred; the ref was written via update-ref with the all-zero old value, not checkout, branch or reset

setup: a bare fork with branch feat, cloned so refs/remotes/origin/feat exists and refs/heads/feat does not
the trunk's HEAD and working tree status are recorded
check.pseudocode: for mode in [hub,origin]: setup(); m,_=hook(...); assert m=='origin_tracking'; assert rev('refs/heads/feat')==rev('refs/remotes/origin/feat'); assert head()==headBefore; assert status()==statusBefore; assert fetchCalls==0; assert runner.recorded no checkout/branch/reset

criteria.condition: neither refs/heads/<name> nor refs/remotes/origin/<name> resolves and PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin
criteria.action: fetch that single branch from the fork and, if refs/remotes/origin/<name> then resolves to a commit, create refs/heads/<name> at that commit and report the resolution method origin_fetch
criteria.contract: the method is origin_fetch; refs/remotes/origin/late exists and equals the fork tip; refs/heads/late equals the fork tip; no other fork branch gained a tracking ref and no tag was fetched

setup: a bare fork and a clone
branch late is pushed to the fork after the clone, so the trunk has neither refs/heads/late nor refs/remotes/origin/late
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin
the real single-branch fetch function and a PAT-less credential resolver
check.pseudocode: m,err=hook(ctx,slug,'late'); assert m=='origin_fetch'; assert rev('refs/heads/late')==forkRev('late'); assert tags()==tagsBefore; assert trackingRefs()==before+{late}

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is unset, its lookup returns an error, or its value is anything other than the exact string origin
criteria.action: treat the workspace as hub mode: perform zero fetches and zero origin credential lookups, including when the branch exists nowhere
criteria.contract: A counting fetch stub and a counting credential-resolver stub both record 0 calls

setup: a counting fetch stub and a counting credential resolver stub
a branch that exists nowhere in the trunk
check.pseudocode: for getter in [unset,err,'hub','Origin','ORIGIN']: _,err=hook(...); assert isNotFound(err); assert fetchCalls==0 && credCalls==0

criteria.condition: a registration request starts
criteria.action: read PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE once for that request using the parsing helper of 20_fork_patch_sync, so that a change of the variable takes effect on the next request
criteria.contract: the first request answers 400 with no fetch; the second request answers 201 and the audit method is origin_fetch; each request reads the variable exactly once

setup: an HTTP registration handler with the real resolver and a counting variable getter
a branch that exists only on the fork
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is hub
check.pseudocode: r1=post(); assert r1.status==400 && fetchCalls==0; setVar('origin'); r2=post(); assert r2.status==201 && fetchCalls==1; assert getterCalls==2

criteria.condition: the submitted name resolves only as a tag, a SHA or a remote-qualified name such as origin/x and not as refs/heads/<name> or refs/remotes/origin/<name>
criteria.action: reject the branch as not found, using fully qualified refs for every existence check
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with the not-found message of 21-REQ-4; no row inserted and no local branch created

setup: a trunk with tag v1, a commit SHA, and refs/remotes/origin/x
no refs/heads for these names and no refs/remotes/origin/v1
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is hub
check.pseudocode: for n in ['v1',sha,'origin/x']: r=post({branch_name:n}); assert r.status==400; assert count(patches)==0; assert not refExists('refs/heads/'+n)

criteria.condition: no branch-check hook is registered
criteria.action: accept the branch without any resolution, as before this spec
criteria.contract: the status is 201; a patch row is inserted

setup: no resolver hook is registered
the branch exists nowhere
check.pseudocode: ResetHook(); r=post(); assert r.status==201; assert count(patches)==1

requirements.title: Creating the local branch
requirements.rationale: The local ref must be written without disturbing the trunk's working tree and must be safe against a concurrent hub push.

criteria.action: create the local branch only with update-ref refs/heads/<name> <sha> <all-zero-sha>, never with checkout, branch or reset, leaving the trunk's working tree and HEAD unchanged
criteria.contract: exactly one update-ref call with args refs/heads/feat <sha> 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000; no checkout, branch, reset or switch command was run

setup: a recording git runner wrapping the real runner
a tracking-only branch feat
check.pseudocode: hook(...); calls=runner.calls(); assert ['update-ref','refs/heads/feat',sha,ZERO] in calls; assert none(c[0] in ['checkout','branch','reset','switch'] for c in calls)

criteria.condition: the compare-and-swap create fails because refs/heads/<name> now exists
criteria.action: re-run the resolution from step 1 and report the resolution method local
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 for the registration; the existing ref is not modified

setup: a tracking-only branch feat
a runner wrapper that creates refs/heads/feat at a different commit just before the hub's update-ref executes
check.pseudocode: runner.beforeUpdateRef=lambda: git('update-ref','refs/heads/feat',other); r=post(); assert r.status==201; assert audit.meta.branch_resolution=='local'; assert rev('refs/heads/feat')==other

criteria.condition: writing refs/heads/<name> fails for any reason other than the ref already existing
criteria.action: log the error with the slug and branch, insert no patch row and answer with an internal error
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message internal server error

setup: a tracking-only branch
a runner whose update-ref fails with a non-exists error such as a read-only refs directory
a captured log
check.pseudocode: r=post(); assert r.status==500 && r.msg=='internal server error'; assert count(patches)==0; assert slug in log and branch in log

criteria.action: for any created local branch, point it at the tracking tip at the moment of creation and write no upstream tracking configuration
criteria.contract: refs/heads/<name> equals the tracking tip at creation; the trunk's .git/config has no branch.<name>.remote or branch.<name>.merge entry

setup: a real fork and clone with randomly generated valid branch names and commit chains
check.pseudocode: for name,tip in gen(): hook(name); assert rev('refs/heads/'+name)==tip; assert configGet('branch.'+name+'.remote') is None and configGet('branch.'+name+'.merge') is None

requirements.title: Single-branch fork fetch
requirements.rationale: Only the one requested branch is of interest at registration time; pruning and tags are sync's concern.

criteria.condition: resolution step 3 runs
criteria.action: run a go-git fetch of the trunk's origin remote with the single refspec +refs/heads/<name>:refs/remotes/origin/<name>, no tags, no pruning, and credentials from workspace.ResolveCloneAuth (GIT_PAT, then GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD, then none)
criteria.contract: the stub receives the trunk path, refspec +refs/heads/feat:refs/remotes/origin/feat as the only refspec; the stub receives the auth value returned by the credential resolver; the fetch request has no tags and no prune; the credential resolver is called once with the slug

setup: origin mode
a recording fetch stub and a credential resolver returning a known auth method
check.pseudocode: assert stub.refspecs==['+refs/heads/feat:refs/remotes/origin/feat']; assert stub.auth==expectedAuth; assert stub.tags==NoTags && !stub.prune; assert credCalls==1

criteria.condition: the fetch returns git.NoErrAlreadyUpToDate
criteria.action: treat the fetch as successful and continue with the tracking-ref check
criteria.contract: with the tracking ref present the method is origin_fetch and the local ref is created; with the tracking ref absent the result is branch not found, not a fetch failure

setup: origin mode
a fetch stub returning git.NoErrAlreadyUpToDate after a tracking ref was made to appear (or not)
check.pseudocode: stub.returns(NoErrAlreadyUpToDate); m,err=hook(); assert m=='origin_fetch' and err==nil (case A); assert isNotFound(err) (case B)

criteria.condition: the fork does not have the requested branch and the fetch reports that no remote ref matches
criteria.action: classify the failure as branch not found on origin, create no local branch and insert no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with the message of 21-REQ-4

setup: a real bare fork without branch ghost
origin mode and the real fetch function
a second case where the fetch error text is rewritten to a misleading string but the error type is unchanged
check.pseudocode: r=post('ghost'); assert r.status==400; assert not refExists('refs/heads/ghost'); assert classify(wrap(NoMatchingRefSpecError, 'xyz'))==NotFound; assert classify(errors.New('couldn\'t find remote ref'))!=NotFound

criteria.condition: the fetch fails for any reason other than the branch being absent on the fork (unreachable fork, authentication failure, transport error)
criteria.action: log the error text, create no local branch, insert no row and not echo the error text in the response
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message origin fetch failed and error type origin_fetch_failed

setup: origin mode
the trunk's origin URL points at a nonexistent path or closed port
a captured log
check.pseudocode: r=post(); assert r.status==502 && r.type=='origin_fetch_failed' && r.msg=='origin fetch failed'; assert underlyingText not in r.body; assert underlyingText in log; assert count(patches)==0

criteria.condition: origin credential resolution fails
criteria.action: skip the fetch, create no local branch and insert no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 502 with message failed to resolve origin credentials

setup: origin mode
a credential resolver stub that returns an error
a counting fetch stub
check.pseudocode: creds.err=errors.New('x'); r=post(); assert r.status==502 && r.msg=='failed to resolve origin credentials'; assert fetchCalls==0 && count(patches)==0

criteria.action: decide that a branch is not found on origin from a typed go-git error or by listing the remote's refs, and never from matching on error text alone

requirements.title: Error for a branch found nowhere
requirements.rationale: Clients need one stable message regardless of mode.

criteria.condition: a single-patch registration names a branch that no resolution step finds (steps 1 and 2 in hub mode, steps 1 to 3 in origin mode)
criteria.action: reject the request, insert no row and create no local branch
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with message branch does not exist in repository or on origin

setup: a trunk where the branch exists neither locally, as tracking ref, nor on the fork
check.pseudocode: for mode in [hub,origin]: r=post(); assert r.status==400 && r.msg=='branch does not exist in repository or on origin'; assert count(patches)==0; assert not refExists(...)

criteria.condition: a batch registration contains an element whose branch no resolution step finds
criteria.action: reject the request naming the first failing element and insert no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 400 with message patch[i]: branch does not exist in repository or on origin, where i is the zero-based index of the first failing element

setup: a batch of three patches where element 0 exists locally and elements 1 and 2 exist nowhere
check.pseudocode: r=postBatch([local,missing1,missing2]); assert r.status==400 && r.msg=='patch[1]: branch does not exist in repository or on origin'; assert count(patches)==0

criteria.action: for any registration of a branch found nowhere, return the identical 400 message in hub mode and in origin mode
criteria.contract: both responses have status 400; both messages are equal to branch does not exist in repository or on origin

setup: a real fork and clone
a generator of valid branch names absent from the trunk and fork
check.pseudocode: for name in gen_missing(): a=post(name,'hub'); b=post(name,'origin'); assert a.status==b.status==400; assert a.msg==b.msg=='branch does not exist in repository or on origin'

requirements.title: Skipping the branch check
requirements.rationale: skip_branch_check must keep its meaning as an opt-out of every lookup and side effect.

criteria.condition: a registration element has skip_branch_check true, in either mode
criteria.action: perform no ref lookup, no fetch, no credential resolution, no local branch creation and take no workspace lock for that element
criteria.contract: the status is 201; fetch, credential and lock counters are 0; the runner recorded no ref lookup and no update-ref; no refs/heads/<name> exists

setup: a branch that exists nowhere
counting stubs for fetch, credentials and lock, and a recording git runner
run once with hub and once with origin
check.pseudocode: r=post(skip=True); assert r.status==201; assert fetch==0 and creds==0 and lockCalls==0 and runner.calls==[]; assert not refExists(...)

criteria.condition: a batch mixes skipped and non-skipped elements
criteria.action: decide each element independently, so that a skipped element does not change how its neighbours resolve
criteria.contract: the status is 201 and four rows are inserted; only elements 1 and 3 get local branches; element 0 and 2 get no local ref; the fetch stub is called once, for element 3 only

setup: origin mode
a batch: element 0 skipped and absent, element 1 tracking-only, element 2 skipped, element 3 fork-only
check.pseudocode: r=postBatch(mixed); assert r.status==201 && count(patches)==4; assert refExists(el1) and refExists(el3) and not refExists(el0) and not refExists(el2); assert fetchCalls==1

requirements.title: Batch registration
requirements.rationale: A batch must stay all-or-nothing for rows while resolution may leave harmless refs behind.

criteria.action: validate and resolve every element, in array order, before inserting any row
criteria.contract: the resolver is called for elements 0,1,2 in array order and the insert happens only after all succeed; the statuses are 400, 502, 409 and 500 respectively; in each failing case the patch table row count is unchanged; the first failing element stops the loop (later elements are not resolved)

setup: a batch of three patches where the third element triggers, per case, not-found, fetch failure, busy lock and internal ref write error
a recording resolver stub that logs call order
check.pseudocode: for case,status in [(nf,400),(fetch,502),(busy,409),(internal,500)]: r=postBatch(3); assert r.status==status; assert count(patches)==before; assert order==[0,1,2]; assert insertTime>lastResolveTime on success

criteria.condition: any element's resolution fails with a missing branch, a fetch failure, a busy workspace or an internal error
criteria.action: stop at the first failing element and insert no row for any element
criteria.contract: HTTP 400, 502, 409 or 500 respectively; the patch table row count is unchanged

criteria.condition: a later element fails after an earlier element created a local branch or completed a fork fetch
criteria.action: keep the earlier local branches and fetched tracking refs in place
criteria.contract: A later registration of the earlier branch reports the resolution method local

setup: origin mode
element 0 is tracking-only, element 1 is fork-only and fetched, element 2 exists nowhere
check.pseudocode: r=postBatch([a,b,missing]); assert r.status==400; assert refExists('refs/heads/a') and refExists('refs/heads/b'); r2=post('a'); assert r2.status==201; assert audit.branch_resolution=='local'

criteria.action: run the duplicate-in-batch and already-registered checks after the resolution loop, so that error precedence is unchanged and a batch that answers 409 may already have created local branches
criteria.contract: the duplicate batch answers 409 and the local branch for the tracking-only element exists; the already-registered batch with a missing branch answers 400, not 409; the single request answers 400 before the if_not_exists lookup; no rows are inserted by the failing requests

setup: a batch with a tracking-only element repeated twice, and a second batch with an already-registered branch plus a missing branch
a single request with a missing branch and if_not_exists for an existing record
check.pseudocode: r1=postBatch([t,t]); assert r1.status==409 && refExists(t); r2=postBatch([registered,missing]); assert r2.status==400; r3=post(missing,if_not_exists=True); assert r3.status==400

criteria.action: run resolution before the existence checks and the if_not_exists lookup, so a missing branch answers 400 before a 409 for the same request

requirements.title: Concurrency
requirements.rationale: Sync fetches origin under the workspace lock and hub pushes take no lock, so writes need the lock and a compare-and-swap.

criteria.condition: resolution needs to write a ref (an origin_tracking create or an origin_fetch) and the local check of step 1 failed
criteria.action: take wslock.TryLock(slug) before writing anything and hold it until that element's resolution finishes
criteria.contract: TryLock is called once per branch with the slug; the fetch and update-ref happen while the lock is held; the lock is not held after the hook returns

setup: a lock spy wrapping wslock.TryLock
a tracking-only branch and a fork-only branch in origin mode
a fetch stub and runner that record whether the lock is held at call time
a tracking-only branch
a lock hook that creates refs/heads/feat at a new commit while the lock is being acquired
check.pseudocode:
hook('t'); hook('f'); assert lockCalls==2; assert allWritesObservedLocked; assert !locked()
lock.onAcquire=lambda: git('update-ref','refs/heads/feat',other); m,_=hook(); assert m=='local'; assert runner.updateRefCalls==0 && fetchCalls==0; assert rev('refs/heads/feat')==other

criteria.condition: the workspace lock has been acquired for an element
criteria.action: re-check step 1 before writing, and report local without writing if refs/heads/<name> now resolves

criteria.condition: wslock.TryLock(slug) reports the lock busy
criteria.action: insert no row and not wait for the lock
criteria.contract: HTTP 409 with error type workspace_busy and message another operation is running on this workspace; retry later

setup: the workspace lock is held by another operation
one tracking-only branch (hub mode) and one fork-only branch (origin mode)
check.pseudocode: unlock=TryLock(slug); for case in cases: t0=now(); r=post(); assert r.status==409 && r.type=='workspace_busy' && r.msg==MSG; assert now()-t0<1s; assert count(patches)==0

criteria.action: release the workspace lock before the database insert and on every resolution outcome, success or failure
criteria.contract: after each response TryLock(slug) succeeds again; at the time of the database insert the lock is not held

setup: a lock spy
scenarios: create success, fetch success, not found, fetch failure, write failure
check.pseudocode: for s in scenarios: post(s); u,ok=TryLock(slug); assert ok; u(); assert lockHeldAtInsert==False

criteria.condition: the workspace lock is held by another operation
criteria.action: complete registrations on the local path and for skip_branch_check elements without taking the lock
criteria.contract: HTTP 201 for those registrations

setup: the workspace lock is held by another operation
one branch that exists locally and one that does not exist at all
check.pseudocode: hold=TryLock(slug); r1=post(local); r2=post(missing,skip=True); assert r1.status==201 && r2.status==201; assert registrationLockCalls==0

requirements.title: Audit of the resolution method
requirements.rationale: Operators need to see how a branch was found and to tell not-checked from no-hook.

criteria.condition: a single-patch registration with a registered hook creates a patch
criteria.action: emit hub.patch.create with metadata key branch_resolution set to local, origin_tracking or origin_fetch, next to the existing branch_name and position keys
criteria.contract: the metadata branch_resolution is local, origin_tracking, origin_fetch and skipped respectively; branch_name and position remain in the metadata; the other event fields are unchanged

setup: a hook registered
branches that resolve as local, origin_tracking, origin_fetch, and one skipped with skip_branch_check true
check.pseudocode: for (case,expected) in cases: post(case); ev=lastAudit('hub.patch.create'); assert ev.meta.branch_resolution==expected; assert 'branch_name' in ev.meta and 'position' in ev.meta

criteria.condition: a single-patch registration with skip_branch_check true creates a patch
criteria.action: emit hub.patch.create with branch_resolution set to skipped

criteria.condition: no branch-check hook is registered
criteria.action: omit the branch_resolution key from hub.patch.create
criteria.contract: hub.patch.create is emitted; its metadata has no branch_resolution key but has branch_name and position

setup: no hook registered
check.pseudocode: post(); ev=lastAudit(); assert 'branch_resolution' not in ev.meta

criteria.condition: an if_not_exists request returns the existing record
criteria.action: emit no hub.patch.create event
criteria.contract: the existing record is returned; no hub.patch.create event is emitted

setup: a patch already registered for branch feat
the audit sink is emptied
check.pseudocode: clearAudit(); r=post(feat,if_not_exists=True); assert r.status==200; assert auditCount('hub.patch.create')==0

criteria.action: emit no hub.patch.create events, as before this spec
criteria.contract: status is 201 with two rows; no hub.patch.create event is emitted

setup: a hook registered and an empty audit sink
check.pseudocode: r=postBatch([a,b]); assert r.status==201; assert auditCount('hub.patch.create')==0

requirements.title: Resolver hook contract and wiring
requirements.rationale: One resolving hook avoids two sources of truth and follows the existing hook pattern that avoids an import cycle.

criteria.action: define in internal/workspace/branch_check_hook.go a resolver hook type that takes a context, a slug and a branch name and returns a resolution method and a classified error, replacing BranchCheckFunc
criteria.contract: the statuses are 400, 502, 502, 409 and 500; BranchCheckFunc no longer exists; the stub compiles against the new type (context, slug, branch)

setup: a stub resolver returning each classified error: not found, origin fetch failed, credential failure, workspace busy, other
the resolver hook type in internal/workspace/branch_check_hook.go taking a context, slug and branch name and returning a method and error
check.pseudocode: for (err,status) in table: RegisterBranchCheckHook(func(ctx,slug,b)(Method,error){return '',err}); assert post().status==status

criteria.action: classify hook errors as at least branch not found, origin fetch failed (including credential resolution failure), workspace busy and other, and map them in the handlers to 400, 502, 409 and 500

implement the resolver hook in internal/carrypatch, constructed from the git runner factory, the workspace root, the variable getter store.GetVariableValue, the origin credential resolver of 20_fork_patch_sync and an injectable single-branch fetch function, and register it from cmd/af-hub/main.go in place of the inline rev-parse --verify closure
criteria.contract: the constructed hook uses the injected fetch stub and getter; main.go registers the carrypatch resolver; main.go no longer contains an inline rev-parse --verify branch-check closure

setup: carrypatch resolver constructor accepting git runner factory, workspace root, variable getter, credential resolver and fetch function
the source of cmd/af-hub/main.go
check.pseudocode: h=carrypatch.NewBranchResolverHook(factory,root,getter,creds,fetch); assert usesStubs(h); src=read('cmd/af-hub/main.go'); assert 'RegisterBranchCheckHook(carrypatch.' in src; assert 'rev-parse --verify' not in branchCheckClosure

criteria.action: keep the workspace package free of imports of carrypatch and the carrypatch package free of imports of workspace
criteria.contract: internal/workspace does not depend on internal/carrypatch; internal/carrypatch does not depend on internal/workspace

setup: the module's package graph from go list -deps
check.pseudocode: assert 'internal/carrypatch' not in goListDeps('internal/workspace'); assert 'internal/workspace' not in goListDeps('internal/carrypatch')

criteria.condition: the resolver hook returns an error that carries no recognised classification
criteria.action: treat it as an internal failure and insert no row
criteria.contract: HTTP 500 with message internal server error

setup: a stub hook returning a plain errors.New("boom")
check.pseudocode: hook=func(...){return '',errors.New('boom')}; r=post(); assert r.status==500 && r.msg=='internal server error'; assert 'boom' not in r.body; assert count(patches)==0

requirements.title: Documentation and CLI surface
requirements.rationale: Project steering treats outdated docs as regressions.

criteria.action: describe in the registration section the resolution order, the 400 message branch does not exist in repository or on origin, the 409 workspace_busy and 502 origin_fetch_failed responses, the skip_branch_check behaviour and the branch_resolution audit metadata
criteria.contract: it mentions local, origin_tracking and origin_fetch in order; it contains branch does not exist in repository or on origin; it documents 409 workspace_busy and 502 origin_fetch_failed; it describes skip_branch_check and the branch_resolution metadata with the skipped value

setup: docs/api.md after the change
check.pseudocode: s=section('api.md','Patches'); for needle in [...]: assert needle in s

criteria.action: update the POST /workspaces/{slug}/patches description, its 400 description and the skip_branch_check property description, and add 409 and 502 responses
criteria.contract: the description mentions the resolution order; the 400 description mentions branch does not exist in repository or on origin; responses 409 and 502 exist; the skip_branch_check property description states that no lookup, fetch or local branch is made

setup: docs/openapi.yaml parsed as YAML
check.pseudocode: op=yaml['paths']['/workspaces/{slug}/patches']['post']; assert '409' in op.responses and '502' in op.responses; assert 'or on origin' in op.responses['400'].description

criteria.action: update the afc patch add entry and the --skip-branch-check flag text, and update the command's help text, to describe the new resolution behaviour
criteria.contract: both mention local, tracking and fork resolution and that the server decides by PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE; the --skip-branch-check text says the lookup, fetch and local branch creation are skipped

setup: docs/cli.md and the patch add cobra command
check.pseudocode: assert 'origin' in cmd.Long and 'skip' in flag.Usage; assert needles in section('cli.md','patch add')

criteria.action: add no new flag and send the same request body as before this spec, so that the existing CLI test passes unchanged
criteria.contract: the request body equals the pre-change body; the flag set equals the pre-change flag set; the existing CLI test passes unmodified

setup: the existing CLI test for afc patch add and a recording test server
check.pseudocode: run('patch','add',...); assert body==expected; assert flagNames(cmd)==oldFlagNames

criteria.action: leave docs/carry_patch_workflow.md unmodified
criteria.contract: the diff is empty

setup: the base revision and the working tree
check.pseudocode: assert git_diff('docs/carry_patch_workflow.md')==''

execution_paths.title: Operator registers a fork-only branch known to the clone in hub mode

steps.action: runs afc patch add for a branch that exists only as refs/remotes/origin/<name> in a hub-mode workspace
reads PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE (hub) and calls the resolver hook
finds no refs/heads/<name>, takes the workspace lock, finds the tracking ref and creates refs/heads/<name> with a compare-and-swap update-ref, then releases the lock
inserts the patch row, emits hub.patch.create with branch_resolution origin_tracking and returns 201

setup: the hub HTTP server with real handler, resolver, git runner, workspace lock, database and audit sink
a real bare fork and a clone as trunk with the branch only as refs/remotes/origin/<name>
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE unset
end_state: the response is 201
refs/heads/<name> exists at the tracking tip
the row exists
hub.patch.create has branch_resolution origin_tracking
the workspace lock is free afterwards

execution_paths.title: Operator registers a branch pushed to the fork after the clone in origin mode

steps.action: submits POST /workspaces/:slug/patches for a branch that exists only on the fork, with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE set to origin
finds neither local nor tracking ref, takes the workspace lock and resolves origin credentials with ResolveCloneAuth
fetches only +refs/heads/<name>:refs/remotes/origin/<name> from the fork and creates refs/heads/<name> at the fetched tip
inserts the patch row, emits hub.patch.create with branch_resolution origin_fetch and returns 201

setup: the hub HTTP server with real handler, resolver, ResolveCloneAuth, go-git fetch and database
a real bare fork, a clone, and a branch pushed to the fork afterwards
PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is origin
end_state: the response is 201
